handoff_to_lead.script_body:
set -euo pipefail
SRC=/Users/wane/SynovaAgent/.synova-wt-b2-d1050
DEST=$HOME/Synova-过程档案/出库-主仓
cd "$SRC"
mkdir -p "$DEST/.claude/task-briefs"
N=0
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  mkdir -p "$DEST/$(dirname "$p")"
  cp -p "$p" "$DEST/$p"
  N=$((N+1))
done < /tmp/b2-outbound-list.txt
echo "COPIED=$N"
# ---- sha256 逐件对账（N/N 全等）----
MATCH=0; MISMATCH=0
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  a=$(shasum -a 256 "$SRC/$p" | awk '{print $1}')
  b=$(shasum -a 256 "$DEST/$p" | awk '{print $1}')
  if [ "$a" = "$b" ]; then MATCH=$((MATCH+1)); else MISMATCH=$((MISMATCH+1)); echo "MISMATCH: $p"; fi
done < /tmp/b2-outbound-list.txt
echo "SHA256_MATCH=$MATCH"
echo "SHA256_MISMATCH=$MISMATCH"
echo "DEST_FILES_IN_TASKBRIEFS_TOP=$(find "$DEST/.claude/task-briefs" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.md' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
if [ "$MISMATCH" -ne 0 ] || [ "$MATCH" -ne "$N" ]; then echo "RECONCILE_FAIL"; exit 3; fi
git -C "$HOME/Synova-过程档案" add -A 出库-主仓
git -C "$HOME/Synova-过程档案" -c user.name=synova-archive -c user.email=archive@synova.local \
  commit -q -m "chore(D1050-B2): 承接主仓 .claude/task-briefs/ 非 archive 存量出库 275 件（保形）" -- 出库-主仓
echo "ARCHIVE_COMMIT=$(git -C "$HOME/Synova-过程档案" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "ARCHIVE_HEAD_COUNT=$(git -C "$HOME/Synova-过程档案" ls-files 出库-主仓 | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
echo "OK"
